mapper.sql: id, submission_no, match_id, season_id, stage_id, round_id, group_id, platform_code, home_team_id, away_team_id, submitter_team_id, submitter_member_id, submitter_player_id, submitter_role, version_no, previous_submission_id, home_score, away_score, winner_team_id, submission_status, audit_status, submitted_time, reviewed_time, reviewed_by, reviewed_by_name, reject_reason, audit_remark, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_data_submission (submission_no, match_id, season_id, stage_id, round_id, group_id, platform_code, home_team_id, away_team_id, submitter_team_id, submitter_member_id, submitter_player_id, submitter_role, version_no, previous_submission_id, home_score, away_score, winner_team_id, submission_status, audit_status, submitted_time, reviewed_time, reviewed_by, reviewed_by_name, reject_reason, audit_remark, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{submissionNo}, #{matchId}, #{seasonId}, #{stageId}, #{roundId}, #{groupId}, #{platformCode}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{submitterTeamId}, #{submitterMemberId}, #{submitterPlayerId}, #{submitterRole}, #{versionNo}, #{previousSubmissionId}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{winnerTeamId}, #{submissionStatus}, #{auditStatus}, #{submittedTime}, #{reviewedTime}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedByName}, #{rejectReason}, #{auditRemark}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select from basket_match_data_submission where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_match_data_submission where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 for update
select from basket_match_data_submission where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 order by version_no desc, id desc limit 1
select from basket_match_data_submission where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 and submission_status in (1, 2) order by id desc limit 1

select s.id as submissionId, s.submission_no as submissionNo, s.match_id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, s.season_id as seasonId, sea.season_name as seasonName, s.stage_id as stageId, st.stage_name as stageName, ht.team_name as homeTeamName, at.team_name as awayTeamName, s.home_score as homeScore, s.away_score as awayScore, stt.team_name as submitterTeamName, ifnull(mp.nickname, concat('会员', s.submitter_member_id)) as submitterMemberName, s.version_no as versionNo, s.submission_status as submissionStatus, s.audit_status as auditStatus, s.submitted_time as submittedTime, (select count(1) from basket_match_data_submission_material mat where mat.submission_id = s.id and mat.is_delete = 0) as materialCount, 0 as riskFlag from basket_match_data_submission s inner join basket_match m on m.id = s.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament_season sea on sea.id = s.season_id and sea.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament_stage st on st.id = s.stage_id and st.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ht on ht.id = s.home_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team at on at.id = s.away_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team stt on stt.id = s.submitter_team_id and stt.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = s.submitter_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.season_id = #{seasonId} and s.stage_id = #{stageId} and s.group_id = #{groupId} and (s.home_team_id = #{teamId} or s.away_team_id = #{teamId}) and s.match_id = #{matchId} and s.submission_status = #{submissionStatus} and s.audit_status = #{auditStatus} order by s.submitted_time desc, s.id desc
select count(1) from basket_match_data_submission where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_match_data_submission set submission_status = #{toSubmissionStatus}, audit_status = #{toAuditStatus}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_by_name = #{reviewedByName}, reviewed_time = now(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and submission_status = #{fromSubmissionStatus} and audit_status = #{fromAuditStatus} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select s.id as submissionId, s.version_no as versionNo, s.submission_status as submissionStatus, s.audit_status as auditStatus, stt.team_name as submitterTeamName, ifnull(mp.nickname, concat('会员', s.submitter_member_id)) as submitterMemberName, s.submitted_time as submittedTime, s.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, s.reject_reason as rejectReason, case when s.submission_status in (1, 2) then 1 else 0 end as isCurrent from basket_match_data_submission s left join basket_team stt on stt.id = s.submitter_team_id and stt.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = s.submitter_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where s.match_id = #{matchId} and s.is_delete = 0 order by s.version_no desc, s.id desc
